required_inputs.question_manifest: Freeze N exact question IDs/texts and R repeats, explicitly distinguishing the exposed Calvin development case from a fresh held-out set. No reused proof60 authored cases labelled unseen.
required_inputs.source_manifest: Freeze exact public documents/source revision/release, full fragment text/hash and available original source offsets. Declare unknown parent/continuation spans; do not invent them.
required_inputs.retrieval_condition: Formal E0 is no retrieval; formal E1 is frozen basic dense RAG. Freeze dense encoder/revision, vector corpus fingerprint, k and selection/window policy. Current chat R2/reranking must remain a separately labelled product variant.
required_inputs.generation_and_checker_config: Freeze model IDs, exact provider route, supported decoding/reasoning/output limits, role prompts, timeout, finite repair/recheck budget, order/randomisation and cache/warmup conditions. Establish a current reviewed controller and approved credential consumer without paused historical controllers or shadow routes.
required_inputs.reference_and_scoring: Freeze independent reference/rubric before outcomes. Score common factual accuracy/coverage across arms; score E1 citation support separately. Keep invalid/refused/failed observations in the intended denominator and leave missing human judgments null.
required_inputs.native_timing: Use actual isolated API/worker and native browser send-to-complete-DOM timestamps. Distinguish benchmark E0/E1 from product interactive/general_knowledge/R2 variants; preserve raw paired receipts and failures. A single pilot does not establish p95 or noninferiority.

outbound_content_scope_needed_for_next_b.generation_E0: Each frozen new test question and fixed test instructions/profile/context; no retrieved textbook context.
outbound_content_scope_needed_for_next_b.generation_E1: The same question/instructions/profile/context plus the frozen actual dense-selected public textbook excerpts.
outbound_content_scope_needed_for_next_b.checking: Each newly generated E0/E1 answer, exact test question, relevant frozen public reference/evidence and checker instructions; distinguish source candidate metadata from semantic judgments.
outbound_content_scope_needed_for_next_b.boundary: These new questions, newly generated answers and paired arm calls are outside the final one-request same71/saved-answer selection-check allowance. A concrete next-batch manifest/controller/budget must define their scope; the prior user fee authorization is not withdrawn.

call_bounds.same_cap_includes: All provider calls, including initial generation/checking, local patch/full recheck, format repair and checker-contract corrections. No additional automatic retry; stop as an observed failure when the arm cap is exhausted.
call_bounds.one_case_one_repeat_no_repair: The plan for one completed valid paired baseline is two generation requests plus two full checker requests = four POSTs. Early failed/refused cases can submit fewer requests and remain in the intended denominator.
call_bounds.one_case_one_repeat_one_local_patch_and_: Four initial requests plus two patch requests plus two complete rechecks = eight POSTs maximum; no automatic repeat or full-regeneration loop.
call_bounds.whole_batch_no_repair: 4*N*R planned for completed valid baselines; actual failures/refusals can submit fewer calls without removal from the denominator.
call_bounds.whole_batch_bounded_repair: At most 8*N*R with an enforced total cap of four provider calls per arm, local/deterministic query preparation and no other paid stage; otherwise enumerate every extra role call before submission.
call_bounds.budget_requirement: Freeze N/R/roles and exact supported wire/output limits, verify current route price caps, reserve every possible submitted request and retain UNKNOWN holds. Do not infer a new financial grant from this document.
